report_title: EY Four Trends Redefining Cash Management
executive_summary: The cash management landscape is rapidly transforming from transactional to strategic, data-driven services, leveraging AI/ML and digital assets. Banks must evolve their value propositions to offer resilient, future-ready treasury solutions and become strategic advisors. This shift is driven by client demand for real-time insights, automated processes, and tailored experiences, presenting both opportunities and risks from traditional and non-traditional competitors. CMIplus must embrace these trends to enhance client relationships, secure market share, and remain competitive in the evolving corporate banking ecosystem.

key_stats.description: 73% of survey respondents say digitizing treasury functions is a challenge.
44% of respondents will use managed services from banks to address the challenges of digitization.
90% of CFOs and treasurers are comfortable using an AI financial advisor that makes recommendations.
92% of corporate treasurers are comfortable using sector-specific platforms tailored to their industry's unique needs.
71% of corporate treasurers say there is a lack of suitable sector-centric tools to address their unique financial situation.
Over 75% of institutional investors expect to increase their allocations to digital assets in 2025.
59% of institutional investors will allocate more than 5% of assets under management (AuM) to digital assets or related products.

themes.name: Treasury Automation to Business Intelligence
themes.description: Cash management is evolving from basic process efficiency to advanced business intelligence. This involves real-time, automated treasury solutions like virtual accounts, AI-based forecasting for funding gaps, and algorithmic liquidity engines. The goal is to provide clients with greater control, improved working capital management, and informed short-term investment decisions, moving beyond simple transaction processing.
themes.key_stat: 73% of survey respondents say digitizing treasury functions is a challenge.

themes.name: Data-Driven Strategic Advisory
themes.description: Banks are transitioning from transactional processors to strategic advisors by leveraging high-value internal and external data. This includes integrating macroeconomic indicators, supply chain data, and sector benchmarks to offer proactive insights, predictive alerts, and actionable recommendations tailored to clients' specific operational needs and business models, fostering deeper client relationships.
themes.key_stat: 90% of CFOs and treasurers are comfortable using an AI financial advisor that makes recommendations in response to financial issues.

themes.name: Industry-Specific Solutions as Standard
themes.description: Generic financial products are no longer sufficient; clients expect cash management services tailored to their industry's unique dynamics. This necessitates developing verticalized solutions with customized cash flow tools, liquidity structures, and payment terms, complemented by specialist human expertise and digital services via virtual channels, to meet specific sector requirements and build trust.
themes.key_stat: 92% of corporate treasurers are comfortable using sector-specific platforms tailored to their industry's unique needs.

themes.name: Blockchain & Digital Assets Integration
themes.description: The increasing adoption of digital assets like stablecoins and tokenized deposits, coupled with regulatory clarity, presents significant opportunities. Banks can enhance collateralization, reconciliation, and settlement processes through tokenization, expand their client base to digital-native firms, and integrate new technologies into existing cash management solutions, opening new methods of value exchange.
themes.key_stat: Over 75% of institutional investors expect to increase their allocations to digital assets in 2025.

key_actions.action: Develop AI-powered, client-centric automation for treasury functions.
key_actions.rationale: Clients demand real-time, automated solutions with configurable rules and override options. CMIplus can leverage AI for forecasting, liquidity management, and virtual account structures to centralize visibility and reduce idle cash, aligning with EBICS/H2H automation and Open Banking APIs for enhanced control and efficiency.
key_actions.timeline: Short-term (pilot AI features) to Mid-term (integrate across core offerings)

key_actions.action: Transform CMIplus into a data-driven strategic advisory platform.
key_actions.rationale: Move beyond transaction processing by integrating internal transaction data with external macroeconomic and sector-specific data. CMIplus should provide predictive insights, proactive alerts, and actionable recommendations, enhancing its value proposition as a long-term enterprise partner, especially for multi-currency payments and corporate treasury optimization in CEE.
key_actions.timeline: Mid-term (data integration and analytics development) to Long-term (full advisory service rollout)

key_actions.action: Introduce industry-specific cash management solutions and partnerships.
key_actions.rationale: Clients increasingly evaluate banks based on their understanding of specific industry operational languages and needs. CMIplus should develop tailored cash flow tools, liquidity structures, and payment terms for key CEE sectors, potentially through partnerships, to deepen wallet share, differentiate against competitors, and provide relevant solutions for ISO 20022 and SEPA.
key_actions.timeline: Mid-term (identify target industries and design solutions) to Long-term (implement and expand)

competitive_implications: The cash management market is highly competitive, with FinTechs and big tech players challenging traditional banks. CMIplus must proactively adopt advanced technologies like AI, data analytics, and digital assets to avoid commoditization, strengthen client relationships, and maintain relevance against both incumbent and non-traditional competitors. Failure to innovate risks losing market share and client loyalty, particularly in the dynamic CEE market.

case_studies.headline: Virtual Account Management (VAM) for enhanced control and security.
case_studies.key_achievement: Offers self-service tools for designing and managing virtual account structures, centralizing treasury functions across multiple entities, and supporting sector-specific funding segregation and customized reporting.
case_studies.lesson: Virtual account management is a key enabler for client self-service, enhanced control, and tailored reporting, crucial for complex corporate structures and project-based funding, aligning with CMIplus's multi-entity and multi-currency capabilities.

case_studies.headline: Partnership with Loop to streamline freight payment processes.
case_studies.key_achievement: Developed an AI-based solution that accelerates payments and removes inefficiencies in the trucking industry's legacy payment systems, improving working capital for shippers and carriers.
case_studies.lesson: Strategic partnerships with FinTechs can deliver highly specialized, AI-driven solutions that address specific industry pain points, leading to significant efficiency gains and improved working capital, a model CMIplus could explore for CEE sectors.

case_studies.headline: Tailored Treasury Management Solutions for healthcare providers.
case_studies.key_achievement: Offers integrated solutions for patient accounting, consolidated payment reconciliation, remote deposit, and a National Lockbox Network, supporting electronic funds transfer, commercial cards, and fraud protection with detailed reporting.
case_studies.lesson: Deep industry understanding allows for the creation of comprehensive, verticalized solutions that address specific sector challenges, strengthening cash flow and patient satisfaction. CMIplus should identify key CEE industries for similar tailored offerings.

executive_summary: The 2025 McKinsey Global Payments Report highlights a payments industry at a turning point, characterized by increasing fragmentation, the rapid adoption of digital assets, and the transformative power of AI. While global payments revenue growth is moderating to 4% annually, the shift towards lower-cost account-to-account (A2A) payments and digital wallets is reshaping revenue models. For CMIplus, this necessitates a strategic focus on enhancing cross-border interoperability, leveraging AI for intelligent cash management, and exploring digital asset integration to remain competitive and trusted by large international corporates in CEE.

key_stats.description: Global payments revenue growth slowed to 4% in 2024.
Global payments revenue is projected to reach $3.0 trillion by 2029.
Cash usage declined to 46% of worldwide payments in 2024 (down from 50% in 2023).
A2A payments via digital wallets now account for approximately 30% of global point-of-sale volume.
Stablecoin issuance has doubled since early 2024.
Daily stablecoin transaction volumes are around $30 billion.
EMEA payments revenue CAGR for 2019-2024 was 13%.

themes.name: Payments Fragmentation and Regionalization
themes.description: The global payments ecosystem is becoming increasingly fragmented due to geopolitical shifts and a push for payments sovereignty, leading to the rise of diverse local and regional payment systems. This creates a multirail environment where interoperability across different standards and jurisdictions, including CEE, becomes paramount. CMIplus must navigate this complexity to ensure seamless cross-border corporate cash flows.
themes.key_stat: EMEA payments revenue CAGR for 2019-2024 was 13%.

themes.name: Rise of Digital Assets and Programmable Money
themes.description: Stablecoins and tokenized money are gaining significant traction, driven by increasing regulatory clarity and technological advancements. These assets offer new possibilities for real-time, 'always-on' cross-border payments, intraday liquidity management, and programmable use cases for corporate treasuries. CMIplus needs to evaluate how these innovations can enhance its multi-currency offerings and potentially disrupt traditional deposit-based revenue models.
themes.key_stat: Stablecoin issuance has doubled since early 2024.

themes.name: AI as a Transformative Force
themes.description: Artificial Intelligence is fundamentally reshaping the payments landscape, driving efficiencies in transaction optimization, software engineering, fraud detection, and risk management. The emergence of 'agentic AI' capable of autonomous transactions will further redefine how payments are initiated and processed. CMIplus can leverage AI to offer smarter routing, automated reconciliation, and enhanced security for its corporate clients.
themes.key_stat: 10% of consumers use AI to start online shopping journeys.

themes.name: Shifting Revenue Models and Cost Pressures
themes.description: Payments revenue growth is moderating, with a notable shift towards lower-cost payment options like account-to-account (A2A) transfers and digital wallets. This trend, coupled with ongoing pricing pressures, challenges traditional fee-based revenue models and net interest income. CMIplus must explore new monetization strategies and value-added services to maintain profitability in this evolving landscape.
themes.key_stat: A2A payments via digital wallets now account for approximately 30% of global point-of-sale volume.

themes.name: Interoperability and Ecosystem Play
themes.description: In a modular and programmable world, success hinges on becoming a foundational layer within broader ecosystems, rather than operating in isolation. Seamless interoperability across diverse payment rails, asset types, and compliance regimes will be a core differentiator. CMIplus's Open Banking APIs, EBICS, and H2H channels are critical enablers for integrating with corporate ERPs and treasury management systems.
themes.key_stat: Global payments revenue is projected to reach $3.0 trillion by 2029.

key_actions.action: Enhance Cross-Border Interoperability and Regional Scheme Integration
key_actions.rationale: The report emphasizes increasing regionalization and the need for seamless multirail connectivity. CMIplus's focus on international corporates in CEE requires robust cross-border solutions beyond traditional SWIFT, integrating with emerging regional instant payment systems and leveraging ISO 20022.
key_actions.timeline: Ongoing, with pilot integrations for key CEE regional schemes within 12-18 months.

key_actions.action: Develop AI-Powered Intelligent Cash Management Services
key_actions.rationale: AI is a major force for efficiency and value creation in payments. CMIplus can differentiate by offering 'autonomous payment infrastructure' through AI-driven smart routing, enhanced fraud detection, automated reconciliation (eBAM, VoP), and advanced liquidity management for corporate treasuries.
key_actions.timeline: Begin R&D and pilot projects within 6-12 months, phased rollout over 24-36 months.

key_actions.action: Explore Digital Asset Integration for Corporate Treasury Use Cases
key_actions.rationale: Digital assets, particularly stablecoins and tokenized deposits, are gaining regulatory clarity and offer potential for 'always-on' real-time payments and programmable money. Investigating their application for intraday liquidity and cross-border settlement could provide a competitive edge for multi-currency corporate cash management.
key_actions.timeline: Feasibility study and sandbox pilots within 12-24 months.

key_actions.action: Strengthen Open Banking API Ecosystem and Programmable Compliance
key_actions.rationale: The report stresses playing through ecosystems and codifying compliance into infrastructure. CMIplus needs to be the 'layer others build on' by expanding its Open Banking API offerings for deeper ERP/TMS integration, while building modular, programmable compliance engines to adapt to diverging regulations across its network banks.
key_actions.timeline: Continuous API development, implement programmable compliance modules within 18-24 months.

competitive_implications: The payments landscape will become intensely competitive, with traditional revenue models facing pressure from lower-cost rails and AI-driven efficiencies. CMIplus must differentiate by offering superior, AI-enhanced, and highly interoperable solutions that build trust and simplify complex corporate treasury operations across fragmented regional systems. Failure to adapt risks disintermediation by agile specialists or larger platform providers.
